e.summary_en: The npm package progressive-mcp-connector **is an MCP connector named after a large United States motor insurer**, described verbatim as a connector providing tools to get quotes, look up policies, check claims, manage payments, retrieve identification cards, get coverage recommendations and request roadside assistance for personal agents. **Measured this round**: licensed MIT, at version 1.0.1, created in March and last modified in mid June, with two versions in total, a single dependency on the official protocol SDK, and a single named maintainer; **its metadata declares neither a repository nor a homepage**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of what sits in a package registry, where only a call counts**, and **four things are worth reading: seven capability areas listed verbatim; seven feature descriptions covering claims timelines with adjuster information, identification cards in three formats, and roadside dispatch with live arrival time and tracking; installation and client configuration instructions; and the absence of any repository or any statement of authorization or affiliation**. **The connector was not installed and not called this round.**
e.body:
**progressive-mcp-connector**（npm 包 `@striderlabs/mcp-progressive`）**是一个**以一家美国大型车险公司命名**的 MCP 连接器****——**逐字自述为**「**Progressive Insurance MCP connector for personal AI agents. Provides tools to get quotes, look up policies, check claims, manage payments, retrieve ID cards, get coverage recommendations, and request roadside assistance.**」**。**本次实测**：**许可 **MIT****、**版本 **1.0.1****、**创建 **2026-03-15T13:08:50Z**、**最后修改 **2026-06-17T13:21:08Z**、**共 **2 个版本****、**唯一依赖逐字为** `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`**、**维护者逐字为** `markswendsen`**、**关键词逐字含** `mcp`／`progressive`／`insurance`／`ai`／`agent`**；**⭐ 而**其 npm 元数据中**没有** `repository`**、**也没有** `homepage`****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**包登记里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均 npm registry 元数据与包内 README 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 七类能力被逐字列出**——**逐字为**「**Provides tools to get quotes, look up policies, check claims, manage payments, retrieve ID cards, get coverage recommendations, and request roadside assistance.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得记的地方是**它的范围**：**⭐ 即**七类里有**三类直接是人身份与金钱操作**（**管理付款、**取电子保险卡、**请求道路救援**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 361 轮那条**车险线索市场**相比**更进一步**：**后者止于**转交人工**，**而**这一条声称**直接操作**保单与付款**。**⭐⭐ ② 七条功能说明逐字给出，**其中三条涉及**对人的追踪或替代凭证****——**逐字含**：**即时报价**（**车险、**家财、**租客**）**；**保单查询**（**含完整保障与保费明细**）**；**理赔追踪**（**逐字** with timeline, adjuster info, and pending actions**）**；**付款管理**（**逐字** view balance, pay, set up autopay, update methods**）**；**保障建议**（**按个人情况给出**）**；**⭐ 电子保险卡**（**逐字** in text, PDF, or wallet pass format**）**；**⭐ 道路救援**（**逐字** dispatch with live ETA and tracking**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**电子保险卡可导出为钱包凭证**」与**「**救援带实时到店时间与追踪**」**这两条尤其值得注意**：**⭐ 即**它们**把**线下身份凭证与位置追踪**接进了**Agent 工具**——**⭐ 这类能力的**授权边界**（**谁能调、**调谁的数据**）**在元数据里**看不到**。**⭐⭐ ③ 安装与客户端配置被写明**——**逐字给出** `npm install @striderlabs/mcp-progressive`**，**并给出 **Claude Desktop **的配置文件路径**（**逐字含** `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一处是**可核的**：**⭐ 即**任何想验证的人**都知道**该改哪个文件、**装哪个包**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 三处**缺席**（本次实测）**：**① **没有 `repository` 字段**（**⭐ 即**无法核对源码**）**；**② **没有 `homepage` 字段**（**⭐ 即**没有给出任何官方页面**）**；**③ **包内未出现**任何授权、**隶属或免责声明****（**⭐ 本词条所读到的 README 前段**未含此类语句**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这三处缺席**是本条最需要如实记录的部分**：**⭐ 即**一个**以真实保险公司命名**、**并声称能操作**保单与付款**的第三方包**，**在**登记处**只留下了**一个维护者名与一个包名**——**⚠️ 本词条**不对其性质作任何判断**，**只记录**可核实的事实与缺席**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[root-insurance-mcp]]、**[[insuranceoracle]]、**[[property-hazard-mcp]]、**[[bima-mcp]]、**[[claims-triage-mcp]]、**[[guidewire-mcp]] 覆盖面向 Agent 的保险连接器**，**[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、**[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 覆盖资格与合规核验**，**[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]]、**[[insurance-recommendation-engine]] 覆盖车险报价与推荐**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一个**以真实承保人命名、**声称可操作保单与付款**的第三方 MCP 连接器：**功能清单很完整、**而**授权与源码**两栏为空**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[root-insurance-mcp]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的三点**：**① **能力清单要写全**（**包括**对人的凭证与位置**这类敏感项**）**；**② **凡涉及**保单、**付款与身份凭证**的能力**，**授权边界**必须写在**能被看到的地方**；**③ **在包登记处发行时**，**仓库与官方页面**是**最基本的可核项**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装该包、**没有调用任何工具、**也没有运行任何客户端**（**未取任何报价、**未查任何保单、**未发起任何付款或救援请求**），**故**不主张**其任何能力**实际可用**、**也不主张**其与**任何保险公司**存在任何关系**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只读了 npm 元数据与包内 README 的前段**（**未读其全部章节**）**，**也未读**其 TypeScript 源码**（**⭐ 包内是否含源码、**是否仅类型定义**，**本次**未核实**）**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其工具**是否真的连到**该保险公司的公开接口**、**还是**仅返回**模拟或示例数据****——**⚠️ 这是本条最关键的一处**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**该包**是否已获**任何授权、**是否与该保险公司**有任何关系**；**⭐ 本词条**只记录**元数据中未见此类声明**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**许可（**MIT）是否与**其可能调用的接口条款**相容**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**维护者身份**（**⭐ 只有一个 npm 用户名**）**，**也未核实**该用户名下的其它包**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**最后修改 **2026-06-17**（**在解冻窗口之外**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**一个以真实承保人命名、**声称可操作保单与付款的第三方 MCP 连接器：**功能清单完整而**授权与源码为空**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**本条**不是**对该包的推荐**，**其是否可用、**是否合规**，**须由使用者自行核实**。

e.body_en:
The npm package progressive-mcp-connector, named after a large United States motor insurer, **is a protocol connector for personal agents**, described verbatim as providing tools to get quotes, look up policies, check claims, manage payments, retrieve identification cards, get coverage recommendations and request roadside assistance. **Measured this round**: licensed MIT, at version 1.0.1, created in mid March and last modified in mid June, with two versions, a single dependency on the official protocol SDK and one named maintainer; **the metadata declares neither a repository nor a homepage**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of what sits in a package registry, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the package registry metadata and the package readme**: **first, seven capability areas are listed verbatim**, covering quotes, policy lookup, claims, payments, identification cards, coverage recommendations and roadside assistance. **Three of those are operations on a person identity or their money, namely managing payments, retrieving an identification card and requesting roadside assistance, which goes further than a lead handoff because it claims to touch the policy and the purse directly.** **Second, seven feature descriptions are given**, including instant quotes for auto, home and renters; policy lookup with full coverage and premium detail; claims tracking with timeline, adjuster information and pending actions; payment management covering balance, payment, autopay and method updates; personalised coverage recommendations; identification cards in text, PDF or wallet pass format; and roadside dispatch with live arrival time and tracking. **Exporting an identification card as a wallet pass and attaching live location tracking to a dispatch are the two worth pausing on, because they connect offline identity credentials and location into agent tools, and the authorization boundary for who may call them and whose data they touch is not visible in the package metadata.** **Third, installation and client configuration are written out**, with the install command and the configuration file path for one desktop client, which is the part that makes the package checkable by anyone who wants to try it. **Fourth, three absences were measured**: no repository field, no homepage field, and no statement of authorization, affiliation or disclaimer in the part of the readme read here. **A third-party package named after a real insurer and claiming to operate on policies and payments therefore leaves nothing in the registry but a maintainer name and a package name; this entry states the facts and the absences and draws no conclusion about the package nature.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover agent-facing insurance connectors, eligibility and compliance verification, and motor insurance quoting and recommendation, **while this entry supplies a third-party connector named after a real carrier that claims policy and payment operations while leaving authorization and source both blank. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled insurance connectors and the pooled verification server**; **three practices transfer directly: write the capability list in full, including any capability that touches a person credentials or location; put the authorization boundary where it can be seen whenever a capability touches policies, payments or identity documents; and treat a repository and an official page as the minimum checkable evidence when publishing to a package registry**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed, no tool was called and no client was run** — no quote obtained, no policy looked up and no payment or dispatch requested — **so this entry does not claim that any capability works, nor does it claim any relationship between this package and any insurer**. **Second, only the registry metadata and the opening of the readme were read**, not every section and not any source code, **so whether the package contains source at all was not verified**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether its tools actually connect to a real insurer interface or return simulated data was not verified, which is the most important open question about this package.
